utterances.speaker: Manager
utterances.text: I have some great news for you today. You have been selected for the senior developer position.

utterances.speaker: Alice
utterances.text: Are you serious? I have been waiting and working towards this for over two years!

utterances.speaker: Manager
utterances.text: Yes absolutely. Your performance this quarter was truly outstanding and the team noticed.

utterances.speaker: Alice
utterances.text: I am so thrilled and deeply grateful. This opportunity means everything to me!

utterances.speaker: Manager
utterances.text: However, the role does require you to relocate to another city within three months.

utterances.speaker: Alice
utterances.text: Oh... I did not expect that at all. I am really worried and anxious about leaving my family behind.

utterances.speaker: Manager
utterances.text: We completely understand it is a significant decision. Please take your time to think it through.

utterances.speaker: Alice
utterances.text: I appreciate your understanding but honestly right now I feel very uncertain and anxious about this.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Hey, I really need to talk to you about something very serious that happened.

utterances.speaker: Jordan
utterances.text: Of course, what is going on? You look upset.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: I heard from multiple people that you shared my personal secret with the entire group.

utterances.speaker: Jordan
utterances.text: I only mentioned it once casually. I honestly did not think it was such a big deal.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Not a big deal? I trusted you completely with something deeply private. I am so angry and hurt right now.

utterances.speaker: Jordan
utterances.text: I am truly sorry Sam. I should never have said anything, I deeply regret it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sorry does not undo the fact that everyone now knows something very personal about me.

utterances.speaker: Jordan
utterances.text: You are absolutely right. I feel terrible about what I did to you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: I just feel so completely betrayed. I never ever thought you would do something like this to me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Hey can everyone please gather in the main hall? I have something important to announce.

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: What is happening? You are being very mysterious and secretive today Leo.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Nothing special, just come along with me please.

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: Okay fine, I am coming.

utterances.speaker: Crowd
utterances.text: SURPRISE! Happy Birthday Maya! We love you so much!

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: Oh my goodness! I absolutely cannot believe this! I am completely shocked and so overwhelmed right now!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: We secretly planned every detail of this for three full weeks without you finding out even once.

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: I had absolutely no idea whatsoever. I feel so incredibly touched that you all did this for me. I feel loved!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: We did all of this because you always give so much of yourself to everyone else around you.

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: I am honestly going to cry now. This is the most wonderful and thoughtful thing anyone has ever done for me.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: The final exam results have just been posted online. Have you checked yours yet?

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Not yet honestly. I am terrified to look at them after how the exam went.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: I just checked mine and I actually passed with a distinction! I am so incredibly happy and relieved!

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: That is absolutely amazing Priya! You worked so incredibly hard for this and you truly deserved it.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Thank you so much! Now please go check yours right away, I am confident you did well too.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: I just checked and I failed the paper by only two marks. I cannot believe it.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Oh no Ravi, I am so genuinely sorry to hear that happened to you.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: I studied day and night and gave everything I had. I feel completely devastated and so hopeless right now.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Please do not give up. You should definitely apply for re-evaluation of your paper.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: I know you are right, but knowing I was only two marks away makes the pain even more unbearable for me.

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: I just noticed that my name was completely left out of the project credits in the final report.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: The manager made a decision that only the project leads would receive formal credits this time around.

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: But I personally contributed more than half of all the code written for this entire project.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: I know that and I did raise your name and contributions with management. But the decision was already final.

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: I am absolutely furious about this. It is completely unfair and deeply disrespectful towards my work.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: I completely understand your frustration Tom. I honestly would feel exactly the same way if I were you.

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: I am seriously considering whether I even want to continue working here because of how this was handled.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: Please do not make a hasty decision you might regret. Let us escalate this issue together through proper channels.

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: Fine, but if absolutely nothing changes after this, I will be deeply disappointed and I may have to leave.

utterances.speaker: Doctor
utterances.text: I have thoroughly reviewed all your test results and I need to have a serious discussion with you about them.

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Of course doctor, please tell me everything you found. I want to know the complete truth.

utterances.speaker: Doctor
utterances.text: The scans have revealed a small tumour. The good news is that it appears to be in the very early stage and is highly treatable.

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: A tumour? I was not at all prepared to hear that word. I am absolutely terrified right now.

utterances.speaker: Doctor
utterances.text: I completely understand your fear. However when caught this early the treatment success rate is well above ninety percent.

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: That is somewhat reassuring to hear, but I am still very frightened about what the surgery and treatment will involve.

utterances.speaker: Doctor
utterances.text: We will carefully walk you through every single step of the process together. You will not be alone in facing this.

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Thank you so much for saying that. I feel a little less scared now hearing those words, though I am still quite anxious.

utterances.speaker: Doctor
utterances.text: That feeling is completely normal and expected. Let us schedule all the next steps at a pace that feels comfortable for you.

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: I am truly grateful for your support and compassion. I just really hope and pray that everything goes well.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I miss you so deeply. It has now been three full months since we were last together in the same place.

utterances.speaker: David
utterances.text: I miss you too more than words can express. This distance between us is really taking a very hard toll on me.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I feel incredibly lonely every single time I come home to this empty apartment by myself.

utterances.speaker: David
utterances.text: I know exactly how you feel. I hate that I cannot be physically present there to support and comfort you.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Sometimes I find myself genuinely wondering whether this distance is slowly and silently breaking us apart.

utterances.speaker: David
utterances.text: Please do not say that. You are literally the very reason I keep pushing forward and going every single day.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Really? Hearing you say that makes me feel so much better and more at ease right now.

utterances.speaker: David
utterances.text: I have actually been carefully saving up for months now. I am planning to visit you next month as a big surprise.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Oh my goodness are you being serious right now?! I am so unbelievably excited I feel like I could scream with joy!

utterances.speaker: David
utterances.text: One hundred percent serious. I simply could not bear hearing the sadness and loneliness in your voice anymore.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: You have absolutely no idea just how incredibly happy this makes me feel. I love you so very much.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Where were you last night? You told me directly that you were staying late at the office to work.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: I was actually out spending time with some friends. I know I should have been honest and told you the truth.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: You looked me right in the eyes and lied to my face. How could you possibly do that to me?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: I was honestly afraid that if I told you the truth you would get upset and angry about it.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: I am not upset about you going out with friends at all. I am absolutely disgusted that you chose to lie to me directly.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: You are completely right and there is truly no excuse whatsoever for what I did. I lied and that was wrong.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Every time I think about you looking me in the eyes and lying I just feel genuinely sick to my stomach.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: I genuinely regret it more than I can say. I absolutely hate that I made you feel this way because of my cowardice.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: I need some time completely alone to properly process all of this. I am just so deeply and profoundly disappointed in you.
